question.text: Which of the following is incorrect with respect to property indicated?

solution.text: $\mathrm{F}_{2}$ is expected to have highest bond energy but the correct decreasing order is $\mathrm{Cl}_{2}>\mathrm{Br}_{2}>\mathrm{F}_{2}$ because of fluorine atom has very small size due to which there is a high inter electronic repulsion between two fluorine atoms so the bond between two fluorine gets weaker and need less energy.
